tools.name: get_faq
tools.description: Return Startup Archive's frequently asked questions and answers about captures, private sites, embeds, and availability.

tools.name: get_pricing_plans
tools.description: Return Startup Archive's credit packages and the capture features included with each snapshot.

tools.name: list_archived_startups
tools.description: List the latest public startup captures in Startup Archive. Results can be filtered by startup name, handle, or site URL.

query.description: Optional case-insensitive startup name, handle, or URL filter.

limit.description: Maximum number of startups to return.

tools.name: prepare_site_submission
tools.description: Prepare the new-site submission form for the user to review. This does not submit the site or consume a credit. The user must review the form, complete the security check, and submit it themselves.

url.description: The main public http or https URL to archive.

name.description: The project name displayed in Startup Archive.

slug.description: Optional preferred archive slug. If omitted, the submission form derives one from the URL.

paths.description: Optional routes on the same site, such as about or pricing. Use paths, not full URLs.

originalUrl.description: Optional original URL when the submitted URL is a replacement for an offline or redirecting domain.

visibility.description: Public projects can appear in Explore. Unlisted projects are accessible by direct link.

captureDarkMode.description: Whether to prepare both light and dark mode captures.
